front.title: Identity Evidence for Approver Enrollment and Payee Destination Binding

abstract.t: This document profiles how a relying party uses external identity evidence when it admits a consequential action, without that evidence ever standing in for permission. It defines two separate assertions, approver enrollment and payee destination binding, an authenticated binding from the exact evidence bytes to the action they support, offline status evidence with a freshness bound the relying party chooses, and the refusals that follow when any of it is missing. It applies to the pre-execution Authorization Bundle of EP Authorization Receipts and to the Command Authority Envelope for operational technology, and through the action digest to the Binding Moment Envelope.
